faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.disclaimer: This information is for guidance only and does not replace professional legal advice.

nda.q: What happens if confidential information is disclosed?
nda.a: The disclosing party may be held liable for damages. Check the indemnification clauses and liability limits in the contract.

nda.q: Does the NDA have an expiration date?
nda.a: Yes, check the term date. Many NDAs have confidentiality obligations that extend beyond the contract term.

nda.q: What information is covered by the NDA?
nda.a: This is usually defined in the 'Confidential Information' clause. Look for possible exclusions (publicly available information, received from third parties, etc.).

prestacao_servicos.q: What happens if SLAs are not met?
prestacao_servicos.a: Check the penalty clauses and resolution mechanisms. There may be credit rights or termination options.

prestacao_servicos.q: How does the renewal of this contract work?
prestacao_servicos.a: Depends on the renewal type. If automatic, it renews unless notice is given within the notice period.

prestacao_servicos.q: Can I subcontract part of the services?
prestacao_servicos.a: Check the subcontracting clause. Some contracts expressly prohibit this.

fornecimento.q: What are the delivery and acceptance conditions?
fornecimento.a: Check the delivery clauses, deadlines, locations and conditions for acceptance or rejection of goods.
The contract should define the claims process, warranty periods and liability for defects.
Check the Incoterms or transport clauses to understand who bears the risks and costs of shipping.

saas.a: Check if there is a DPA (Data Processing Agreement) attached and if data categories are defined.

saas.q: What happens if the provider ceases operations?
saas.a: Check continuity and data portability clauses. Having an exit plan is recommended.

saas.q: Can I cancel at any time?
saas.a: Depends on duration and renewal type. Fixed-term contracts typically require fulfilment until the end.

arrendamento.q: What is the notice period for non-renewal?
arrendamento.a: Check the 'Notice Period' field. Portuguese law defines legal minimums that may prevail.
Check each party's obligations. Typically structural works are the landlord's and non-structural the tenant's.

arrendamento.q: Can the landlord enter the property?
arrendamento.a: Yes, but under specific conditions defined in the contract and law. Advance notice and consent are usually required.

trabalho.a: The probation period varies by contract type and role. Check the contract and current labor legislation.
Termination follows specific Labor Code rules, with minimum notice periods based on seniority.

trabalho.q: What are the rights to holidays and allowances?
trabalho.a: Check the contract and applicable CCT. The law guarantees minimums (22 working days of holidays, holiday and Christmas allowances).

licenciamento.q: Can I sublicense to third parties?
licenciamento.a: Depends on the licence terms. Check if the contract is exclusive and whether sublicensing is permitted.

licenciamento.q: What happens when the licence expires?
licenciamento.a: Check obligations to cease use, return materials and renewal rights.
Yes, generally. Check the geographic and use restrictions in the contract.

parceria.q: How are profits and costs distributed?
parceria.a: Check the revenue sharing and cost responsibility clauses. They should be explicit and quantified.

parceria.q: How is a dispute between partners resolved?
parceria.a: Check the dispute resolution clause (mediation, arbitration or court). Mediation is preferred for speed.

parceria.q: Can I exit the partnership early?
parceria.a: Check the exit clauses, lock-in provisions and financial consequences of early exit.

consultoria.a: Check that the contract specifies deliverables, acceptance criteria and deadlines clearly.
Some contracts prohibit the consultant from working for competitors during and after the contract. Check the scope and duration.

consultoria.q: Who owns the intellectual property created?
consultoria.a: Check the IP clause. By default it may belong to the consultant unless otherwise agreed contractually.

outro.q: How can I renew this contract?
outro.a: Check the renewal type. If automatic, the contract renews automatically unless notice is given within the deadline.

outro.q: Where can I find attached documents?
outro.a: Documents are available in the 'History' > 'Attachments' tab on the contract page.

default.q: How can I renew this contract?
default.a: Check the renewal type. If automatic, the contract renews automatically unless notice is given within the deadline.

default.q: Where can I find attached documents?
default.a: Documents are available in the 'History' > 'Attachments' tab on the contract page.
